subject: [PATCH RESEND 1/7] locking: add opt-in tracking of sleeping lock holders

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch introduces an opt-in tracking system for sleeping lock holders in the Linux kernel. It allows tasks to count and report the number of locks they hold that have opted into this tracking, enabling a cheap way to check if a task is holding a lock that other tasks may be waiting for. This feature can help avoid stalls caused by memory allocation while holding shared locks, such as cgroup_mutex or kernfs_rwsem. The patch adds new APIs and infrastructure to support this feature, including a new header file and kernel configuration options.
